title: Constructive extraction of $q$ on Bring's surface
html: On Bring's surface, V \otimes V \cong V_1 \oplus V_0. The R-matrix eigenvalues are q and -q^{-1}. By the Hecke relation the unordered pair \{q, -q^{-1}\} is intrinsic; the positive-definite dagger selects q > 0. The categorical parameter q is a real-valued function on M: at each point p \in M the braiding spectrum extracts a local q(p) \in \mathbb{R}_{>0}. The observed substrate parameter q_0 at the point of observation is an empirical value, not derived from the topology of Bring's surface; the Euler characteristic \chi_{\mathrm{eu}}(M_0) = -6 constrains the quantum dimension [2]_q but does \emph{not} fix the pointwise value of q_0.
